longform.title: They Saved the Same $84,000. One Retired With $359,000 More.
longform.description:
Is investing halal — and is "playing it safe" actually costing you money? Adam and Sammy are both 30. Same salary ($58,000), same savings ($12,000), same $200 a month. Thirty years later, one has $110,000 and the other has $469,000. Neither saved a dollar more than the other.

Then a third man, Bilal, asks the question this entire comparison ignores — and builds his wealth without touching riba.

⏱ CHAPTERS

1:47 Sammy chooses ownership

3:59 Year 3: Sammy is losing
5:23 Most people sell here
6:13 Year 7: the quiet crossover
7:05 The invisible cost Adam never sees
7:42 What the bank really pays you
8:09 Year 10: the honest checkpoint
10:15 Lender vs. owner — the real divide
11:18 Year 30: the final numbers
12:40 The fair objections
13:59 Bilal: the halal portfolio
15:07 Riba, mudaraba & screening
15:53 Bilal's result — second place, on purpose
17:35 Next time: two men, one car, an $8,000 difference

This is Episode 1 of Deen & Dinar — where we run the numbers, then run them halal.

Nothing here is financial advice. Assumptions are stated in the video (8.5% long-run average, with the 6% case shown too). If you need your money within a few years, none of this applies to you — the video says so, honestly.

Subscribe for Episode 2.
